name: The Planets
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator of the heavens and the earth, establishing the celestial bodies—including the sun, moon, and stars—as part of His intentional design (Genesis 1:1, 14). These heavenly lights serve divine purposes such as marking time and seasons, reflecting God’s order and wisdom. The psalmist acknowledges the heavens as the handiwork of God’s fingers, declaring His glory and power (Psalms 8:3, 19:1), while Deuteronomy warns against worshiping these created lights, emphasizing that God alone is to be worshiped. The firm foundation of the earth and the heavens underscores God’s unchanging authority over all creation (Psalms 104:5).
